lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is non-uniform, with narrower intervals in the anterior section (~15-20 pixels) widening to ~40 pixels in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines (8, 9, and 10) are discontinuous, appearing as truncated or dashed segments that terminate before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A sparse cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, located superior to the stifle and anterior to the hind limb margin.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a spiral twist; the structure originates at approximately a 50-degree angle from the frontal bone, curving outward before arching medially at the apical third.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The ratio of the pixel distance between the terminal horn tips to the pixel width of a single horn base is approximately 1.9:1.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately the terminal 12% of the total horn length measured from base to tip.

other_distinctive_markers: A single white chevron across the bridge of the nose, two white spots on the malar region of the cheek, and white transverse bands on the proximal sections of all four legs.
